title: Damper Bread
description: Damper Bread is a dish from Australia featuring all-purpose flour, baking powder, whole cow milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 16 minutes.
Divide and shape the prepared mixture or dough into even portions and arrange on a lined baking sheet or appropriate molds, leaving enough room for expansion.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 35 minutes until set and cooked through.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
